title: hello (bridge -> server)
description: Always the bridge's first frame on a new socket (Arkab.Protocol.hello/4). The key goes here, not in the URL, because URLs end up in proxy logs. The server answers welcome or refused; before hello it listens to nothing else.

bridge.description: The bridge's own id: random, url-safe base64, kept for the bridge's life.

key.description: The key the server gave this bridge at join (join-response.key).

name.description: The bridge's name, for the server's pages.
